brokerConfiguration: RabbitMQ 4.1 defaults; quorum at-least-once retry queue
harnessCorrections: Use docker exec --user rabbitmq for readiness instead of su losing PATH.
Parse Docker labels as JSON to avoid Windows ProcessBuilder nested-quote loss.
Use an explicit free host port because Docker reallocates omitted HostPort mappings on container restart.
An earlier 60-second no-route recovery assertion failed; RabbitMQ defaults to a 180-second internal dead-letter retry interval. The final test allows 210 seconds and leaves broker settings unchanged.
measuredScope: All six cases passed in this single run. The broker case completed in 7.219 seconds because the binding was restored before the recovered quorum queue attempted routing; this run does not measure the worst-case 180-second no-route retry delay.
